title: Does the Job
text: Does the Job. My daughter wanted something to store her t-shirts in her closet. This does the job, but it's not a high quality item. Assembly is required. The directions were straight forward and easy to follow. The finished unit is a bit flimsy. It wil work for her t-shirts as long as she doesn't over stuff them. She does like that you can see inside without opening the drawers. Overall, it's just okay. We're not really sure how long it will last.

product_metadata.title: Ohuhu Storage Bins with Lids, Heavy Duty 3 Pack Plastic Storage Box, Front Opening Storage Cart, Compact Cube Organizer Bins with 4 wheels Stackable for Home Office Organization with Black Pen
features: Firm and Durable: With even more strength and durability, this set of portable storage boxes employs both PP and ABS plastic, allowing them to bear an overall load of 40kg (single box 10kg). With a sleek, understated look and quality design, you're sure to love these plastic organizers!

User-friendly, Thoughtful Design: Built with dual handles, you can grip the stackable storage bins conveniently and carry them around. The front also folds down for easy access! Plus, the rounded corner design means that your kids will be safe to play near it without risking injury.
All-Round Movable Rollers: Slide this storage bin wherever you need to with the 4 all-round rollers on the bottom, 2 of which can be locked to hold it in place.

See-through, Easy to Label: What's inside the household organizer? It's easy to tell thanks to the see-through sides design! You can also use the included whiteboard marker to write on the frame for easy labeling!

Convenient and Compact: There's nothing more convenient than moveable storage! Freely stack these 3-pack wheeled storage bins in any order or any combination you prefer for maximum flexibility. Plus, the 90-degree angled sides make stacking and packing that much easier.
